summary: LocalSetup 4.89.10 updates the pinned CI actions and Python dependencies, keeps packaged dependency exports aligned, and makes existing checks independent of native Git wording and cold worker startup.

highlights.text: CI uses reviewed immutable pins for setup-python 7.1.0 and setup-uv 10.3.2. Regression checks enforce immutable, consistent pins without copying changing release hashes into tests; successful exact-commit validation remains reusable during main integration and publication.
Python updates include OpenAI 3.37.0, setuptools 84.2.1, and Boto3/botocore 1.43.118, with regenerated SDK locks, integrity receipt and hashed storage requirements.

More reliable checks: filesystem-boundary tests bind their simulated Git responses, and concurrent allocation tests prepare requests before the timing barrier. Production behavior, real locking and test deadlines remain unchanged.

compatibility: This maintenance release preserves the framework command and file formats. Dependency exports retain their separate runtime, build and optional storage scopes.
The CI actions continue using Node 24; this update does not change the selected Python version or uv version.
update: Use the normal verified installation or source-refresh procedure. Source checkouts should synchronize their locked environment before running framework tools.
verification: Focused checks passed for dependency exports and integrity (10 tests), action pins (one test), client-state boundaries and process readiness (nine tests), and CLI boundary/privacy behavior (two tests). Final release acceptance additionally requires successful validation of the exact candidate commit.
Verify the framework archive using its .sha256 checksum and .cdx.json SBOM sidecars.
